Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` in full first. Relevant OPEN rows:
- **D-SOURCES.17-1** (V, OPEN) — hosted OSM land (`camreg_osm_surveillance`, ~1.37M claims) into

- **D-FEDERAL.1-1** (V, OPEN, NARROWED) — fresh-window SAM.gov hosted land; not touched by this ticket.

## Requirements (from the ticket, §In-scope + acceptance)

- R1 — a repeatable **read-only** audit verb, deterministic over any spine, emitting: total
  claims/entities/sources; licence mix (claims by `rights_record.spdx_expression`); UNDETERMINED by
  `ingest_run.connector_name`; geolocated entity count (`camera_latitude`/`_longitude`); jurisdiction
  spread (`camera_jurisdiction`); modeling-table population (`resolution`/`jurisdiction`/`coverage_record`/
  `relationship`/`physical_asset`/`value_geom`); compartment split; coverage/freshness. Unit-tested against
  a seeded spine.
- R2 — `docs/build/reports/PUBLIC_SURFACE_AUDIT.md`: the live as-of snapshot + exact queries + results + caveats.
- R3 — frozen per-page data contracts (typed/JSON-schema) covering all ten public surfaces.
- R4 — launch-scope memo: publishable-now vs publishable-after-P27.2; resolution posture recommendation.
- R5 — records: `docs/build/runs/P27.1.md` + PR body.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1 — audit verb runs deterministically on a seeded spine (unit-tested) AND live against hosted `sig-pg`
  read-only; both recorded.
- AC2 — `PUBLIC_SURFACE_AUDIT.md` reports licence mix, UNDETERMINED-by-connector, geolocated count,
  jurisdiction spread, modeling gap with exact queries.
- AC3 — per-page data contracts committed as a typed/JSON-schema artifact covering all ten public surfaces.
- AC4 — launch-scope memo states publishable-now vs publishable-after-P27.2 + recommended resolution posture.
- AC5 — `make check` + `check-build-memory` green; no spine writes; no gate ticked.

## Plan

- Add `exports/src/exports/audit.py`: read-only SQL query constants + pure `build_spine_audit(raw, …)`
  assembler + `run_audit(conn, …)` executor + `SpineAudit.to_json()/to_markdown()`. Never a bare total
  (§32/SIG-METRIC-008): every count renders with its named denominator. Aggregate coordinates only
  (§0.7/§19.4/§43.3) — no per-person/plate field, jurisdiction granularity only.
- Wire `sig-exports audit --dsn … [--as-of --note --json --out --markdown-out]` into `cli.py`.
  Password never in a recorded command — libpq reads `PGPASSWORD` when the DSN omits it; the audit
  records only a redacted DSN (host/db).
- Tests: `tests/exports/test_audit.py` (pure logic + determinism + denominator honesty + no-bare-total,
  runs in `make check`); `tests/db/test_audit_spine.py` (Docker-gated seeded-spine end-to-end).
- Data contracts: `docs/build/reports/PUBLIC_SURFACE_DATA_CONTRACTS.md` + a machine artifact
  `docs/build/reports/public_surface_contracts.schema.json` (10 surfaces).
- Live snapshot: cloud-sql-proxy → psycopg read-only → `PUBLIC_SURFACE_AUDIT.md` (as-of, provisional).
- Decision note: operator instruction advances LEDGER/BUILD_INDEX/run doc/DEFERRALS in THIS PR (the
  ticket's "coordinated pass after P26 lands" note is satisfied — the P27 seed commit a6a2b56 already
  registered manifest rows 117–125 + set nextTicket=P27.1). Per implement-spec Phase 6.5 the worker
  closes its own chain ticket. 00_MANIFEST.md is NOT edited (row 117 already present).
